extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media professionals and the general public seeking ESO press releases
extracted.subtask_description: Conventions and structural elements used on the European Southern Observatory (ESO) press releases listing page — how individual press releases are presented and organized for readers and media. Covers visible metadata, summary/teaser structure, navigation and subscription affordances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press release reference code
rubrics_metrics.description: Each press release is given a short reference identifier such as 'eso2605'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The listing shows a compact alphanumeric code before the title (e.g. 'eso2605 — Press Release'). Use a persistent, short identifier for each release to facilitate citation and linking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title / headline
rubrics_metrics.description: A concise, attention-getting title appears for each press release (e.g. 'First light for PoET: shining (sun)light on exoplanet research').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Headlines are short descriptive phrases that summarise the main result or announcement; they should be clear and suitable for use by media outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date
rubrics_metrics.description: Each press release shows its publication date (e.g. '9 April 2026').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a clear publication date to indicate timeliness and to help chronological sorting and citation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead/teaser paragraph
rubrics_metrics.description: A one-paragraph summary or teaser follows the title and date, giving the key point of the release (e.g. a short synopsis describing the discovery or announcement).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a succinct lead (one or two sentences) that captures the essence of the announcement and invites readers to 'Read more'. This functions as the press-release abstract for quick scanning by journalists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full-release link ('Read more')
rubrics_metrics.description: Each listing includes a 'Read more' link to the full press release content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always provide a prominent link from the summary listing to the full release so that readers and media can access complete details, images, and supporting material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chronological grouping and pagination
rubrics_metrics.description: Press releases are displayed with pagination (showing '1 to 20 of 1367') and grouped by time ranges (e.g., 2021-2026, 2011-2020, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organise releases by date ranges and paginate long archives to make older material discoverable while keeping the main listing navigable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language / localization options
rubrics_metrics.description: The site offers language selection (multiple language variants listed) and a 'Subscribe to receive news from ESO in your language' prompt.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide localized versions of press releases and enable language-specific subscription to serve international media and audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Associated resources and usage guidance links
rubrics_metrics.description: The page links to related resources (e.g., 'Usage of ESO Images, Videos, Web texts and Music', 'Press Room', 'Press kits') and site-wide policies (e.g., cookie policy).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include clear links to image/video usage rules, press kits, copyright and contact information so media know how to use ESO content and whom to contact.
